summary: Thin delegation: reads three DWORD fields (indexes 0, 2 and 5) of the DWORD-pointer argument a1 and forwards them plus argument a2 to sub_5890AA, returning its result unchanged.

operations.description: Call sub_5890AA(a1[5], a1[0], a1[2], a2) and return its return value. The field reads a1[0], a1[2] and a1[5] are passed positionally.

unresolved: Structure layout of a1 is unknown: the meaning of indexes 0, 2 and 5 is not established.
Purpose of argument a2 and the semantics of callee sub_5890AA are outside this function.
